review_notes: Variant WLC.JOS.16.3.v001 is underdetermined and resolves to r00-base, covering s019 and s020; the fallback is among the readings the English permits, so it is not rule 53's excluded case and the projection is aligned as printed (rule 9).

*even unto Gezer*: the *even* was given to the waw and *unto* to `עַד`, per rule 16's count of a conjunction standing before an expanded limit preposition; the competing reading takes *even unto* whole on the `עַד` and leaves the waw unrepresented.
